gaps: Policy has no gold-loan content at all: LTV ratio/cap, eligible purity (18K/22K/24K), valuation method (gross vs net weight, deductions for stones), and the formula for max loan are not specified and must come from the knowledge base or tools

Exact tool sequence and order unspecified: which tool gives gold rate, which computes LTV/eligibility, which lists offers, which submits the application; whether to call search_knowledge_base before quoting scheme rules

Which inputs must be gathered from the customer (weight, purity, desired amount, tenure, repayment type, branch/collateral deposit) and what to do if they are missing, ambiguous, or in different units (grams/tola/oz)
Gold rate source and freshness: which rate (per gram, by purity, buy vs. sell, city), how to handle stale/unavailable rates, and whether the rate on the simulation date 2026-07-16 must be used

Offer selection rules: how to compare schemes (interest rate, processing fee, tenure, LTV), whether to recommend one or present all, and how to handle no eligible offers or requested amount exceeding max eligible

Final action and confirmation: whether 'apply' is a mutation requiring explicit confirmation (policy lists only close/block/cancel/stop as confirm-required), what the application tool needs, and what to report after submission (reference no., next steps like physical gold appraisal at branch)

Customer behavior variations: customer wants to change weight/amount mid-flow, only wants an estimate and not to apply, changes their mind after offers, asks for more than eligible, negotiates rate, or asks about unlinked accounts/IDs
Disbursement account selection: which linked account receives funds, and the requirement to use only the customer's own linked products
Edge cases: gold already pledged, existing gold loan, KYC or eligibility failures, minimum/maximum loan amounts, rate changes between quote and application, rounding conventions, currency/formatting

Communication constraints interplay: must explain results without exposing tool/field names or scheme codes, and product IDs must be looked up rather than invented, so how to present offers to the customer vs. map to IDs is unspecified
Escalation boundary: when a gold loan problem (e.g., valuation dispute, application tool error) warrants transfer vs. service request is not defined
